input.quote: unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
input.rationale: § 3.2 renews each Service Option Attachment automatically unless notice is given at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term. A 90-day window exceeds the fallback ceiling of a 60-day non-renewal notice window, so this is a deviation, cured by the single substitution of sixty (60) days for ninety (90) days in the operative sentence; the mutual either-party notice right, writing requirement, per-Attachment structure and term-end anchor are retained verbatim. The renewal clause permits no uplift — renewal is for a term equal in duration to the previous term on existing terms — so the 5% price-cap element is not engaged; IBM's separate unilateral price-change right in § 13.1 (only after 12 months, on 90 days' notice, with a fee-free Customer exit) is a change-of-terms mechanic and is not double-flagged here. Preferred wording (30-day opt-out, 60-day vendor reminder, 12-month renewal terms) is noted but not pressed; if any Service Option Attachment term exceeds 12 months we would escalate to cap the renewal term at 12 months.

ops.oldText: at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
ops.newText: at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have cut the non-renewal notice window from ninety (90) days to sixty (60) days so an early deadline cannot lock us into a further automatic renewal term; sixty (60) days is our fallback position (our preferred is a thirty (30) day opt-out with a sixty (60) day renewal reminder).
proposal.summary: Cut the § 3.2 non-renewal notice window from ninety (90) days to sixty (60) days.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment
